headline_en: S&P 500 closed higher despite sticky CPI lifting Fed hike odds and oil spiking on Middle East tensions.
executive_bullets_en: S&P 500 rose on last session even as August CPI cemented Fed rate-hike odds and oil prices spiked on Middle East supply risks.
PLTR (ACCUMULATION) offers best opportunity with Stage2 6/7, RS 100.0 and euphoric sentiment at $167.23.
Biggest risk today is further confirmation of Fed hike path via retail sales data or speaker comments.
executive_bullets_ko: 지난 세션 S&P 500는 8월 CPI로 Fed 금리 인상 확률이 높아졌음에도 상승 마감.
PLTR (ACCUMULATION)이 Stage2 6/7, RS 100.0, euphoric 심리로 $167.23에서 가장 주목할 기회.
오늘 실질 리스크는 소매판매나 Fed 발언으로 금리 인상 경로가 더 확인되는 것.

market_mood.explanation_en: The 71.3 regime score is like a river that is flowing but with noticeable cross-currents. It suggests conditions are constructive enough for selective buying yet not strong enough to ignore macro headwinds when deciding whether to buy stocks today.

big_picture.summary_en: Sticky August CPI has cemented market-implied odds of at least one Fed rate hike, driving Treasury yields to multiyear highs. Middle East conflict escalation pushed oil prices sharply higher, yet the S&P 500 still closed up in a clear market paradox.

issues.title_en: Sticky August CPI cements Fed rate-hike odds
issues.title_ko: 8월 CPI 고착화로 Fed 금리인상 기대 확고
issues.current_state_en: August CPI print showed persistent inflation, lifting Treasury yields to multiyear highs and materially raising market-implied odds of at least one Fed rate hike.
issues.current_state_ko: 8월 CPI가 지속적 인플레이션을 확인하면서 국채 수익률이 다년 최고 수준으로 상승하고 Fed 금리인상 확률이 크게 높아짐.
issues.novelty_en: Fresh CPI release on 11 Sep shifted hike probabilities higher ahead of the September FOMC; prior session had lower odds priced.
issues.novelty_ko: 9월 11일 발표된 CPI로 금리인상 확률 상향, 전 거래일 대비 정책 기대 변화
issues.summary_en: Stronger-than-expected inflation data triggered immediate repricing of Fed path, with 2-year yields spiking and S&P 500 closing higher on the day but under rate-hike pressure. Multiple outlets including CNBC, WSJ and Reuters reported the shift on 11 Sep.
issues.summary_ko: 인플레이션 데이터로 Fed 경로 재조정, 2년물 수익률 급등하고 S&P500는 혼조 마감. CNBC·WSJ·Reuters가 9월 11일 일제히 보도.
issues.asymmetric_impact_en: NVDA, META, TSLA, AMZN, GOOGL: negative (higher rates increase discount rates on long-duration growth); CEG, VST: watch (energy cost pass-through)
issues.asymmetric_impact_ko: NVDA·META·TSLA·AMZN·GOOGL: 부정 (고금리로 성장주 할인율 상승); CEG·VST: 주시 (에너지 비용 전가)
issues.market_insight_en: Monitor retail sales and any Fed speakers today for further hike-signal confirmation before FOMC.
issues.market_insight_ko: 오늘 소매판매와 Fed 인사 발언 주시해 FOMC 전 추가 인상 신호 확인
